rules.statement: A lessee who loses possession of leased land due to a partition action and is not under an obligation to intervene in the partition action can claim damages from the lessor for the unexpired portion of the lease, provided that the compensation received does not adequately cover the loss.
rules.supporting_quote: Where the undivided share of a land which was partitioned had been leased and the portion leased had been allotted to a co-owner other than the lessor, who was given compensation.- Held , that the lease was not bound to intervene in the partition action and that he was entitled to claim damages from the lessor.
